terminal_prerequisite_architecture_reope.finding: Every objective prerequisite HAS lawful current representation and a named owner, and all are transportable and validatable/refusable at their declared grains. TD-R03 and its integration ruling independently accept V556 architecture while blocking only implementation on named authority preconditions — which is the definition of bounded implementation debt, not an architecture gap.
